description: Look up flight details by airline, flight number, and departure date before creating or editing a flight segment. Use this when the user gives a flight number and wants to add, preview, or verify a flight.

airline.description: Optional airline name or callsign, such as American Airlines

airline_code.description: Optional IATA or ICAO airline code, such as AA, UA, DL, or AAL

departure_date.description: Local scheduled departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format

flight_number.description: Flight number, with or without the airline prefix, such as AA3242 or 3242

name: flight_quickadd_lookup
title: Look up a flight
